entities.name: Péter Szőke
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Péter Szőke was a Hungarian tennis player. He did not win any top-level titles during his professional career, finishing runner-up once in singles and four times in doubles. He reached his highest ATP singles ranking of World No. 47 in August 1973.
